The value of the engine maintenance, repair, and overhaul (MRO) industry was $27 billion in 2016 and is estimated to reach $40 billion by 2026.
Turbofan engine failures contribute to 60% of all airplane failures, making accurate RUL predictions critical for safety and cost-effective operations.
The CMAPSS dataset contains data for 100 engines until they fail, with the number of operational cycles before failure ranging from 128 to 362, with an average of 206.
The paper removed 12 features from the CMAPSS dataset based on low variability and high correlation criteria.
The Min-Max scaling and power transformation were applied to the preprocessed dataset to normalize the data.
Principal Component Analysis (PCA) was explored but did not yield high accuracies due to the temporal dependencies in the data.
The BLSTM model with dropout layers was the best-performing model, outperforming linear regression, standard LSTM, and other BLSTM variants.
The BLSTM with dropout model achieved an RMSE of 26.68, MAE of 20.56, and R^2 of 0.59 on the CMAPSS dataset.
Early stopping and automatic learning rate reduction were used as additional techniques to improve the BLSTM model's convergence.
The residual plot for the BLSTM with dropout model showed random residuals, indicating the model was well-performing.
The BLSTM model was able to capture the sequential dependencies in the turbofan engine RUL data better than traditional models like linear regression.
The paper suggests that there is still room for improvement in the RUL prediction accuracy, and future work could focus on further hyperparameter tuning and testing on other datasets.
The BLSTM model with dropout regularization was able to minimize the effect of overfitting compared to the standard BLSTM model.
The CMAPSS dataset used in the paper is a simulation framework developed by NASA for examining engine degradation.
The turbofan engine consists of several key components, including the fan, compressors, combustor, and turbines, which are monitored by various sensors in the CMAPSS dataset.
